api: authorize(authenticatedContext, request, trustedResolvedDescriptor, nowMs=Date.now()) -> {allowed, principalId?, requestId?, reason?}

context.delegated?: true requires parentGrants; child allow scope must fit a parent allow and overlap no parent deny

request.requestId: optional effect and refs are assertions only; contradictory values deny

descriptor.resource refs: resolved server-side; authoritative, never copied blindly from client

semantics: resource-limited grants match only the resolved target
payload principal/grants do not affect identity or permissions
invalid, unknown, expired, revoked and contradictory inputs fail closed
limits: synthetic unit proof only; does not authenticate connections, persist revocation/deduplication, or certify OS isolation
stdlib only; no server bind or network auth claim
